Tomato Soup recipe
By: ravikumar
Published: Monday, January 1, 2018 - 3:10am

Ingredients




1 Packet Ching's Secret Tomato Soup
4 Cups (800ml) Water

Preparation

1 Step 1: 2 Mix pack content with 4 cups (800ml) of water till there are no loops. 3 Step 2: 4 Bring to boil. Stirring continously. Simmer for 3 minutes. 5 Serve Hot!!

About

Tomato soup is a delicious and healthy prepared using Chings Tomato soup pack. It is a Quick and Easy Tomato Recipeyou can make it can be served as hot or cold in a bowl. Chinese tomato soup recipe is a healthy and delicious.
